items.title: Osaka Public University — ~500 servers offline
items.summary: Ransomware hit the university's virtualization infrastructure, taking nearly 500 servers down and potentially exposing data on 130,000+ students and alumni; classes were suspended into October.

items.title: DexCom claimed by Redact
items.summary: The Redact group listed medical-device maker DexCom on its leak site on Oct 10; the claim is unverified by the company.

items.title: Andersen Group claimed by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: SilentRansomGroup posted professional-services firm Andersen Group on Oct 6, claiming system disruption and a payment demand.

ransomware.note: Most October victim listings come from leak-site trackers and remain unconfirmed by the named organizations. Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims in September (+30% YoY).

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 regional outage (Oct 20)
items.summary: A 5h32m incident from 08:35 UTC hit twelve services in London (europe-west2), including Compute Engine, App Engine and Cloud Storage.

items.title: Google Cloud Storage write errors, us-central1 (Oct 8)
items.summary: Elevated latency and error rates on GCS uploads and writes in us-central1 lasted 5h52m.

outage.note: No AWS or Azure October 2026 incidents surfaced. Google items come from a third-party tracker, not Google's status page.

items.title: Capcom: 11.7M CAPCOM ID records exposed
items.summary: Capcom confirmed an intrusion detected Oct 19 that exposed 11,774,247 CAPCOM ID records; attackers changed passwords on 196 accounts, and phishing follow-ons are expected.

items.title: Sourcenext (Pocketalk): 22.5M member records
items.summary: Sourcenext disclosed on Oct 15 that unauthorized access to its member-management system may have exposed 22,519,960 records, reportedly including passwords.

items.title: Burger King Japan: server with 11.18M customer records hit
items.summary: The company says the attacked server held 11.18M customer records but no card numbers, and it has found no sign that credentials were accessed.

items.title: CenterPoint Energy breach hits 1M+ Texans
items.summary: The US utility disclosed a breach exposing names, addresses and Social Security numbers of more than 1 million Texas residents.

items.title: Japan National Police Agency data via cloud vendor Arcadia
items.summary: Personal data of about 125,000 officers and staff across 20 prefectural police forces may be compromised after an attack on cloud provider Arcadia.

items.title: ETS breach exposes 5.7M students
items.summary: Educational Testing Service disclosed a breach covering student data going back to 2006.

items.title: Railway and PingCAP: developer-platform intrusions
items.summary: Railway confirmed attackers reached some customer secrets, and PingCAP (TiDB) reported internal access via stolen service-account credentials, with customer impact still under investigation.

items.title: Typhoon Champi sweeps past Taiwan toward China/Japan
items.summary: Champi passed Taiwan on Oct 24, leaving 1 dead, 527 injured and widespread power outages, then tracked north with heavy-rain warnings for China and Japan.

items.title: Southern Utah flash floods damage 80+ homes
items.summary: Repeat flash flooding in Hurricane, Utah has damaged more than 80 homes, and flood warnings were also issued in Colorado.

items.title: M 7.0 — 191 km ENE of Nagqu, Tibet, China (Oct 22)
items.summary: USGS issued an orange PAGER alert, meaning significant casualties and damage are likely.

items.title: Bonin Islands, Japan — M 7.0 doublet + M 6.5 (Oct 24–25)
items.summary: Two M 7.0 events on Oct 24 were followed by an M 6.5 on Oct 25 that carried a tsunami flag; USGS PAGER is green.

items.title: M 6.9 — 197 km WNW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu (Oct 24)
items.summary: An offshore event with a tsunami flag; USGS PAGER is green.

physical.note: Search results that resurfaced old storms (Isaias, Irma, Michael) under 2026 dates were excluded as stale.
